name: RicingScreenshots
description:
Area screenshots straight to the clipboard. Press Print or Shift+Super+S, drag over any part of the screen and the image is copied at once. Then draw on it, add arrows and boxes, highlight or crop it without leaving the desktop. While it is on, it borrows GNOME's Print key (switchable, GNOME's settings are not changed). Super+V records an area as video with the system sound (no microphone); when you stop, save it to Videos or anywhere else, with or without the sound. From the maker of RicingDock.

Clipboard access: the extension only writes the screenshots you take to the clipboard. It never reads the clipboard.
